literal_meaning: খোলা বা উন্মুক্ত অবস্থা (open or unfolded state)
example_sentences_in_bangla: তার চেহারা বেশ খোলতাই হয়েছে বছর কয়েকে।
শিশুটির গাল খোলতাই, দেখতেই ভালো লাগে।
example_sentences_in_english: His figure has become quite plump over a few years.
The child's cheeks are chubby, a pleasure to see.
note: Often used to describe healthy, rounded physical features in everyday Bengali conversation.
